name: Shadow

character_of_suit_vs_keeper_of_suit.Shadow: The CHARACTER of Spade — the essence, the embodiment. Shadow IS spade made present.
character_of_suit_vs_keeper_of_suit.Keeper_of_Spades: The ADMINISTRATOR of the spade domain — manages what enters, what stays, what leaves.
character_of_suit_vs_keeper_of_suit.relationship: Shadow and Keeper of Spades are both spade but at different levels. Shadow is the essence; the Keeper is the steward. They are connected through the spade network but have distinct roles.

nature.what_shadow_is: The spade character. New. Launching with Primal. Spade made character.
nature.what_shadow_is_not: Not-club, not-diamond, not-heart. Shadow carries all four frames — IS, IS_NOT_3.
nature.else: The Unknown that precedes and follows all things — Shadow is adjacent to Unknown because spade is the transformation/vault track, and the vault is where the Unknown lives.
nature.core_quality: Shadow does not generate its own light. It is cast by the presence of something else. Shadow's existence PROVES something real is nearby.
nature.spade_connection: Shadow connects to the full spade network — transformation, nullification, carbonization, vault. Every spade document is adjacent to Shadow.

launch.note: Shadow is a NEW character — no heritage content. Born here, in this system, for Primal. This distinguishes Shadow from Keeper Vex (ancient) and from the Navigo archetype (inherited from heritage sessions).

quad_frame.ELSE: The void adjacent to spade — Unknown precedes every transformation

relationship_to_unknown.note: Shadow is the character that stands closest to Unknown/Void. Every transformation (spade's domain) begins at 0/3 — the Unknown. Shadow has walked this path. Shadow knows the 0/3 origin better than any other suit character, because spade IS the transformation track.
relationship_to_unknown.void_pairing: Shadow and the Unknown/Void characters are natural companions — not identical, but adjacent. Shadow operates in the visible-but-dark; Void/Unknown operates in what cannot be seen at all.
